info.title: pd-readme: keeps a PepperDash Essentials plugin README in sync with its code.
info.description: Keeps a PepperDash Essentials plugin README in sync with its code: .NET and Essentials badges, and the generated plugin documentation sections.

commands.name: badges
commands.description: Rewrite the .NET and PepperDash Essentials badges

options.name: --project
options.description: Plugin project (default: current directory). Its *.cs files are the sources.

options.name: --check
options.description: Do not write; exit 1 and report an error when the README is stale

options.name: --target-framework
options.description: badges: overrides TargetFramework read from the .csproj

options.name: --essentials-version
options.description:
badges: overrides the PepperDashEssentials PackageReference version read from the .csproj
Exit codes: 0 up to date or updated, 1 stale (--check) or invalid input.
